_comment: Read-only source masters. Never edit, crop, resize, recompress, or overwrite the files listed here — re-acquire from the original source if a master needs to change. This manifest exists so the renderer (and any reviewer) can verify a master hasn't drifted from its approved source. Add entries with scripts/add_master.mjs, not by hand.
sourceFolder: REPLACE_WITH_WHERE_YOUR_APPROVED_MASTERS_LIVE (a shared drive folder, an asset-management system link, etc.)

files.note: Example entry — real entries are generated by scripts/add_master.mjs, not written by hand.
